atr10_reference_equivalent.true_range_startup: When prior high is absent, current high-low; otherwise maximum of current high-low,absolute(current high-prior close),absolute(current low-prior close). Valid continuous OHLCV assumed; do not synthesize gap bars.
atr10_reference_equivalent.seed: RMA initializes with a10-value SMA of true range when prior smoothed value is absent. On a complete valid sequence the first nine ATR values are undefined and the tenth is the10-value mean.
atr10_reference_equivalent.update: After seed compute alpha=1/10,beta=1-alpha; form alpha*current true range,form beta*prior ATR,then add the products.
atr10_reference_equivalent.smoothing: Wilder/RMA recurrence after initial SMA seed; not a continually rolling10-bar SMA and not EMA coefficient2/11.
atr10_reference_equivalent.precision_boundary: Preserve the reference operation sequence. Internal native SMA summation, rounding and runtime NaN details are not proved bit-identical; numerical fixtures would validate only the declared mathematical implementation.
atr10_reference_equivalent.missing_data_boundary: Admission must use causal contiguous observations and declared segment state reset/warmup. Documentation examples are not authorization to bridge source-rejected or missing bars.

source_supertrend_state.midpoint: Add high and low,then divide by2
source_supertrend_state.up_update: If prior close strictly exceeds prior up-band,take maximum of basic_up and prior up-band; otherwise basic_up
source_supertrend_state.down_update: If prior close is strictly less than prior down-band,take minimum of basic_down and prior down-band; otherwise basic_down
source_supertrend_state.direction_priority: First compare current close strictly above prior down-band and choose1; otherwise compare strictly below prior up-band and choose-1; otherwise previous direction with missing previous direction replaced by1
source_supertrend_state.startup: Undefined bands do not manufacture comparisons. Initial fallback direction is1. First computable bands do not themselves open a trade; subsequent entry needs a strict direction flip.
source_supertrend_state.equality: Equality to either prior band does not trigger the corresponding strict direction change
source_supertrend_state.preserve_source_difference: Do not replace this recurrence with ta.supertrend or the official generic Supertrend indicator, which may use different band comparison and initialization rules.

default_execution_and_cash_port_design.native_clock: Default historical bar-close calculation; no per-fill or every-tick request; orders normally fill next bar open. No all-na strategy.exit calls exist.
